hero.filename: Mussel Point (Mike Taylor's Midden), Elands Bay, South Africa.jpg
hero.caption: The midden lies in the foreground of the photograph and was excavated by the archaeologist Mike Taylor.  In 2009 it was declared as a provincial heritage site.
